companies.name: Kernel
companies.description: Kernel provides browser infrastructure for AI agents and web automations, offering an API to instantly launch browsers in the cloud with features like anti-bot detection, session reuse, and autoscaling.

companies.name: Browserbase
companies.description: Browserbase is a serverless platform for hosting, managing, and monitoring headless browsers in the cloud, compatible with Puppeteer, Playwright, and Selenium.

companies.name: braintrust
companies.description: Braintrust is a developer platform for building AI products based on large language models, offering tools for evaluations, logging, prompt management, and real-time prompt serving.

companies.name: exa
companies.description: Exa is an AI-powered web search API and search engine built for AI applications, enabling developers to filter and retrieve real-time data from the internet with complex queries.

companies.name: STACKLOK
companies.description: Stacklok builds tools and services focused on software supply chain security, helping developers securely develop and deploy software.
